_comment: GOLDEN CONFIG MANIFEST (2026-09-05).  scripts/make_golden_config.py reads this file,
flattens each lineage's base through its extends chain, pins every knob listed under
'pins' / 'values', and VERIFIES against docs/CONFIG_promotion_ledger.json that no
RECOMMEND_ON / RECOMMEND_SCOPED knob that is IN REGIME for the golden is left unarmed
unless it is named under 'exceptions' with a reason.  The goldens are the standard armed
set made executable: derive every new arm from one of them (copy, then change ONLY the
knob under test + the run paths), and run `python scripts/make_golden_config.py --verify`
whenever the ledger changes — a new ledger row that the goldens do not carry FAILS the
verify, which is the promotion step this project never had.
Paths under runs/ are rewritten per golden name; arms copy the golden and set their own.

goldens.name: golden_sim_tri_w6
goldens.description: SIM lineage: 60-station synthetic truth bed (runs/simnet60_quiet_wu93_24h), GPS L1/L2/L5 + Galileo E1/E5a/E5b, W6 satellite code bias + geometry-free datum, FREE per-LOS slant iono (posture C, no SH), phase_leveling carry (NOT carry_invariant) with the F3 station-wide whitened local block, r2q3 clock anchor, sticky pivot, relevel_free_epoch, the standard QC/observability set.  Validated: SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network §18, SPEC_amb_iono_split_overcount §6.8.

exceptions.network.carry_invariant: mutually exclusive VEHICLE: this lineage carries ambiguities through the phase-leveling F3 block (SPEC_amb_iono_split_overcount); carry_invariant would make F3 inert (do_amb_carry) — the ledger regime now excludes F1/F3 lineages
exceptions.network.estimate_iono_sh: posture C by design: the sim bed grades the FREE per-LOS slant ionosphere against truth (SPEC_synthetic_minimum_network §13, 'NO ionosphere constraint by design'); the SH layer is the FIELD posture (see golden_field_gps_dual)
exceptions.network.clock_datum_sum_to_zero: does NOT graduate (ledger row: 12 h A/B excursion-suppressing but higher steady median; the pin datum stays); also INERT-izes sticky_pivot
exceptions.network.trace_dd_fractional_ref: CONTINUITY, not doubt: the A/B PASSES the structural half and 'oldest' measurably improves the as-traced grade at a returned-reference hour (SPEC_amb_iono §6.13.3, E h5 0.334 -> 0.195 cyc), but the goldens ARE the comparison baseline and changing which satellite their dd-frac trace references would break continuity with the entire existing record of dd-frac grades.  The golden lineages are graded ref-free (simnet_dd_reref.py / --ref-free), which is strictly better than any reference policy, so they gain nothing and lose comparability.  Arm 'oldest' on a standalone/archival trace, not here.

goldens.name: golden_field_gps_dual
goldens.description: FIELD lineage: the 2026-08-08 user-signed-off golden (63-station DOY-129, GPS dual L1/L2, SH-VTEC deg-15 iono, W6 self-contained OSB, Card-4 carry_invariant + PD-safe fold + D5 v3, lane_carry OFF, colocated WTZZ consumer hold-out) flattened through its 5-base extends chain, plus every ledger recommendation that was still unarmed on it (incl. sticky_pivot: this lineage is GPS L1/L2/L5 = the weak-third-signal regime the E3 row recommends; fingerprinted, so fresh lineages only).  F1/F3 do NOT apply here (carry_invariant vehicle; the field F3 arm is owed — SPEC_amb_iono_split_overcount §7).

exceptions.network.clock_datum_sum_to_zero: does NOT graduate (ledger row); the pin datum stays the default
exceptions.network.resume_frame_restore: sim-validated only (SPEC_synthetic §18.14 leg E, 60-sta sim, 2026-09-06): the warm-resume frame + coupling restore has no FIELD arm yet, and this lineage runs carry_invariant (the coupling restore is out of regime without phase_leveling); arm both on the first field warm-resume validation, writer side first (state_snapshot_frame_capture + _coupling_capture)
exceptions.network.trace_dd_fractional_ref: CONTINUITY, not doubt: the A/B PASSES the structural half and 'oldest' measurably improves the as-traced grade at a returned-reference hour (SPEC_amb_iono §6.13.3, E h5 0.334 -> 0.195 cyc), but the goldens ARE the comparison baseline and changing which satellite their dd-frac trace references would break continuity with the entire existing record of dd-frac grades.  The golden lineages are graded ref-free (simnet_dd_reref.py / --ref-free), which is strictly better than any reference policy, so they gain nothing and lose comparability.  Arm 'oldest' on a standalone/archival trace, not here.
exceptions.network.cycle_slip.common_band_scope: FIELD EXCEPTION, re-confirmed by FP-1 (SPEC_event_harness s20.2, 2026-09-13) on the warm-resuming seed: the identity gate passes on every row with the reference-arc clause, but if_phase_td_pairs=all fans a slip on a chain's REFERENCE satellite out to every other satellite of that chain (E1 at GOPE/G24: six false refloats, a 13.7 m innocent phase-bias re-realization, consumer 4.7 vs 1.0 m) with no backstop on carry_invariant (T4 = 0).  Pinned TOGETHER once REF-FAN (s22.6, if_phase_td_ref_arm_all) passes F1-F4 and the s20 bars are re-run on the fixed posture.  History: FIELD HARNESS EXCEPTION (SPEC_event_harness s20, 2026-09-12): field legs at GOPE00CZE (seed ep0604, 60 epochs, event at +10): single-band slips narrow correctly on real data (E1 L5X -99 -> {L5X}; E2 L1C +37 -> {L1C}; E5 L5X -31 with LLI -> {L5X} via rule F3), but the equal-count L1C+L5X +29 slip on G24 narrowed to the INNOCENT band L2W under BOTH if_phase_td_pairs first and all, because G24 is the IF-TD reference satellite of both L5 chains at that station and a reference arc is UNTESTED in the additional chains (its deviation is ref-minus-ref = 0.000000 by construction; 41 such arcs network-wide = exactly one per station, the highest L5-capable satellite in 80.6 % of epochs, rank <= 2 in 99 %).  At G25 (not the reference) pairs=all vetoes exactly (iftd(L1C+L5X)=flagged, 3.15 m vs 0.109 m) and pairs=first keeps L2W.  On carry_invariant the wrong narrowing has no T4 backstop (attribution 0 for 6 h, RAIM-pool re-host gap) and its wire/consumer cost could not be priced: the field golden cannot warm-resume (61/61 epochs withheld at the seam, SH a00 -4810 TECU; Card 1f carry_coupling_gauge_project is the loader-named prerequisite, fingerprinted, absent from the golden - owed as its own card).  FIX STUB before a field pin: a pair whose IF-TD chain holds the satellite as its reference is NOT silent for the verdict (untested => immature => all-band on that arc), re-priced on G24 and G25; then pin together with if_phase_td_pairs = all on a seed that warm-resumes.  SPEC_event_harness s20.1.
exceptions.network.cycle_slip.if_phase_td_pairs: FIELD EXCEPTION, re-confirmed by FP-1 (SPEC_event_harness s20.2, 2026-09-13) on the warm-resuming seed: the identity gate passes on every row with the reference-arc clause, but if_phase_td_pairs=all fans a slip on a chain's REFERENCE satellite out to every other satellite of that chain (E1 at GOPE/G24: six false refloats, a 13.7 m innocent phase-bias re-realization, consumer 4.7 vs 1.0 m) with no backstop on carry_invariant (T4 = 0).  Pinned TOGETHER once REF-FAN (s22.6, if_phase_td_ref_arm_all) passes F1-F4 and the s20 bars are re-run on the fixed posture.  History: FIELD HARNESS EXCEPTION (SPEC_event_harness s20, 2026-09-12): field legs at GOPE00CZE/G25 (equal-count L1C+L5X +29, seed ep0604): all == the (L1C,L5X) IF-TD deviation reads 3.1508 m against a 0.1089 m threshold (29x; 29 cyc x 0.107 m/cyc = 3.10 m predicted) -> veto -> all three bands freed exactly as OFF; first == the pair is never evaluated -> the scope keeps L2W (the innocent band).  The close-spaced pools are healthy on real data (L2W/L5X threshold 0.17 m; the 12x amplification is absorbed; 6 h seed: L1C_L5Q / L1C_L5X pairs 0 flags).  BUT the additional chains do not test their own reference satellite (deviation identically 0 on one arc per station = the highest L5-capable satellite; the first chain's reference arm is not re-run, s14.10.4), so the veto is dead exactly there (G24 at GOPE) - pinned TOGETHER with common_band_scope once the reference-arc clause lands and the field seed can warm-resume (Card 1f).  SPEC_event_harness s20.1.
exceptions.network.scoped_handover_response: GPS-ONLY lineage: the knob's entire benefit is sparing the OTHER constellation's carry at a pivot handover, so with one constellation there is nothing to spare and it is structurally inert (the regime predicate already excludes it; this entry is the record, not a suppression).  Arm it when the field lineage becomes multi-constellation — a field arm is owed then.
exceptions.network.handover_stransform: PREREQUISITE IS ITSELF A FIELD EXCEPTION: network.handover_stransform requires network.scoped_handover_response, which is excepted on this GPS-only lineage, so the regime predicate is false here and the knob is out of regime rather than suppressed.  This entry is the record.  Sim-validated on two beds (SPEC_event_harness §19.6); a FIELD ARM IS OWED, and it is owed behind the prerequisite's field arm, not independently of it.
exceptions.network.carry_invariant_innov_carried_on: PIN DEFERRED (SPEC_event_harness s23, 2026-09-13): RECOMMEND_SCOPED with the mechanism proven on this lineage (twin D5 flags 730 -> 143 = the born share, slip refloats -30 %, pbstep better, wire flat) but the 6 h independent-cold-start twin's consumer bar read +5.3 % p50 / +13 % rms (one satellite's ambiguity level, the invariant-#5 confound); the same-realization 240-epoch pair d5v5_long_{off,on} decides the pin.
